title: Titans-QFWP: A Regime-Aware Hybrid Quantum Fast Weight Programmer for Portfolio Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.29093v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose Titans-QFWP, a hybrid reinforcement learning architecture integrating a Quantum Fast Weight Programmer with Titans-style memory (Persistence, Surprise, and Forgetting) for adaptive portfolio optimization. To address high-dimensional market features, we introduce an enhanced A3C^2 framework with Hungarian-aligned K-means clustering and scaled log-return rewards. Evaluated on 468 S&P 500 stocks under an Equal-Parameter-Count (EPC) benchmark with approximately 3,000 trainable parameters, Titans-QFWP achieves strong performance (median ARR 0.4260, Calmar 8.5504, IR 0.8427). Ablation results reveal that quantum gating fundamentally reshapes memory component roles, with Persistence supporting drawdown control, Surprise contributing to return generation, and Forgetting providing additional stabilization. translated_title: Titans-QFWP：一种面向投资组合优化的市场状态感知混合量子快速权重编程器
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Titans-QFWP，这是一种混合强化学习架构，将量子快速权重编程器与Titans风格的记忆机制（持久性、惊喜性与遗忘性）相集成，用于自适应投资组合优化。为应对高维市场特征，我们引入了增强型A3C^2框架，该框架结合了匈牙利算法对齐的K-means聚类和缩放对数收益率奖励。在468只标普500股票上、采用等参数量（EPC）基准（约3,000个可训练参数）进行评估，Titans-QFWP取得了强劲的表现（中位年化收益率0.4260，Calmar比率8.5504，信息比率0.8427）。消融实验结果表明，量子门控从根本上重塑了记忆组件的角色：持久性支持回撤控制，惊喜性有助于收益生成，遗忘性则提供额外的稳定性。通过稳定这些量子表示，该模型能够在市场回撤期间进行防御性资产配置，同时保留上行收益潜力。
tldr: 提出了融合量子快速权重编程器与Titans风格记忆机制的混合强化学习架构Titans-QFWP，仅用约3000个可训练参数即实现自适应投资组合优化，并通过量子门控重塑记忆组件角色，在市场回撤防御与收益生成之间取得平衡。
en_tdlr: Titans-QFWP is a hybrid reinforcement learning architecture that integrates a Quantum Fast Weight Programmer with Titans-style memory (Persistence, Surprise, Forgetting), achieving strong adaptive portfolio optimization with only ~3,000 trainable parameters, where quantum gating reshapes memory component roles to balance drawdown defense and return generation.
